title: LLV-GHL250Q25: half-log tables with quarter-source allocation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one LLV-GHL250Q25 configuration in proof.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^(sqrt(n)log2(n)+(9/2)sqrt(n))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Main parameters are v=floor sqrt n,ell=ceil log2n,lambda=ceil(ell/2),H_n=bit_length(n^1024-1),m=floor(4096*(v-256ell)/(8H_n+34816)),kappa=ceil log2(m+2)+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2,center=m-1,fan_i=A_bar+2i-center. The exact prefix capacity and one-qubit finishing call include every remainder. Source/leaf caps, all-modulus decoders and finite branch remain explicit. Section14 charges same-level attempts to disjoint leaves and proves internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)+(35/8+1/1024)sqrt(n)+o(sqrt n), with gap127/1024 absorbing every polynomial overhead. All source/LE, lookup/exclusion, gate/address generation, failures, measurements and cleanup count jointly with all other claims.

For this same LLV-GHL250Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical workspace is O(n^(5/2)) bits with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index0. With lambda=ceil(ceil(log2n)/2),2^lambda=O(sqrt n); O(n) retained full-label tables each use O(n^(3/2)) bits. The single current tuple list takes O(n^(3/2)); current input/sort/residue arrays take O(n^2). The source/LE, cap arithmetic, stack, streamed decoder and gate/address ledger fit O(n^2). No full tree, truth table or exponential circuit is stored. These bounds hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GHL250Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Pending vector siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n); the finish and current fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n)<=O(n) scratch, reset/reused between trials. Source/LE, rank/projection, failures and abort cleanup are included. The exact centered sum gives m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GHL250Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired copies number O(2^((1/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. All rejected, failed, discarded and aborted acquisitions count. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Exact centered AM-GM bounds every fan-in prefix by A_bar^m, with finishing through fan_max*A_bar^m. Section8 proves A_bar<=17sqrt(n)/4, log2(17/4)<21/10 and m*H_A/1024<=(v-256ell)/4 for H_A=bit_length(A_bar^1024-1), covering all polynomial cap factors and giving literal nCcap+K<=2^(v/4). Finite lengths change outside constants. All claims hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success.

For the same LLV-GHL250Q25 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
